templates.title: Contract templates
templates.description: Markdown templates with placeholders used by contract mode.
templates.intro_title: A letting file, not a statute book
templates.intro: Starters follow the papers a letting agent actually prepares: authority to market, a reservation offer, the lease, a deposit receipt, the handover protocol, and a vacate undertaking. Contract mode fills them from the listing — owner and tenant, address and layout, rent, deposit, dues, inventory, the official company name and the assigned agent. Deposit caps, tenancy registration, rent-increase indices, cooling-off, notice periods, deposit-protection schemes and required annexes change by country and sometimes by city. Keep the jurisdiction placeholder in the draft and have a local lawyer review it before anyone signs.
templates.list_description: Edit a starter or add your own. Restore starter puts the product copy back without touching other templates.
templates.editor_hint: Insert listing placeholders. Leave the jurisdiction clause in place. Empty fields stay visible in the draft so you do not invent facts.
